title: ZC Labs Created The Zombkolaps!
author: Conspiracy Uncovered
pages: ZC Labs’s lies have been revealed again! They made the Zombkolaps and cannot hide it anymore!
Everyone pretends that ZC Labs just invented the Zombkolaps potion, but we all know that they can’t hide that they can manufacture it in their labs!
So they turn their lies into a marketable poison for Governors to control us more easily!
ZC Labs’s betrayal of the world is more visible than ever. They released this virus to destroy our society.
Keep your eyes out, being able to think critically is now criminalized by the system!
It is no coincidence that these labs spread with the Confederation.

Governors seek to use the Zombkolaps as a way to profit from everyday citizens, both directly through the insane fees needed to access the “cure” from the banks and through making enemies of the state disappear.
Now, Governors don’t even need a zombie to make you disappear, they bottle it up and can throw it at you at a moment’s notice.
It’s all a conspiracy for the governors, the labs, and the banks to control everything. We must resist, we cannot let these groups rule the world!
